column2: Watch the Thank-o-meter. The sad face tells you when someone's misbehaving.
TY from disembarking passengers give you extra time, other TYs do not!
Passengers don't mind if you drive recklessly, just enforce the rules and get to their stop!
Wild weather today, drive safe! Or... drive however you want!
Did I ever tell you about the dream I had about a walking lighthouse?
Honking is critical... if you want to be a goose.
Just because someone looks like trash doesn't mean they're always stinky
Remember: Passengers won't thank you if you let others break the rules
Unjustified slapping will make the victim unhappy
Off-roading is not only allowed but encouraged!
Having trouble reaching the Lighthouse? Your bus can get some great air time.
Parking well is optional, what matters is getting there!
Some passengers break certain rules more than others, keep an eye out.
Ejecting a rulebreaker might help keep others happy, but the ejectee can't thank you
Stuck? Don't hesitate to respawn!
Items from the Shady Dealer don't cost you anything
Try to learn the behavioural cues of your passengers. Different people stink differently!
Passengers are upset by rulebreakers even if they're naughty themselves. Hypocrites!
Try to learn the shortcuts. It'll save you time!
The best drivers can often deduce who's rulebreaking even if the view to them is blocked.
No eating includes drinking. I'm looking at you, Skate Dude.
Items that cancel out rules can really help take the pressure off.
As you level up, your bus will get more passengers at the start of your shift.
As you level up, you will start to unlock starting items. Keep note of what they are!
The garbage trucks in this town are heavy. Don't pick a fight with them.
Your shift will end after 15 stops. Get there in plenty of time for bonus TYs!
The wooden fences around town are VERY well-built. Don't expect to bust through them.
If you need help telling things apart, try Visual Assist Mode in the Settings menu.
Try not to miss your turn. It's a bus, it's not gonna swivel on a dime!
The horn is just for fun. But the BIG horn is for waking passengers.
Check the upper right corner of the map if you need a reminder of the current rules.
Drive on the right. Y'know, if you want.
The bus takes a while to slow down, so a straight bit of road is a great time for slappin'
Give passengers a chance to reform before throwing them off. They'll thank you for it!
If you don't have time to check the map, look for the big traffic cone in the sky.
People won't notice rulebreakers instantly. If you're nearly there, maybe show mercy.
The Thank-o-meter is your friend! Check it often, and deal with rulebreakers to fill it up.
Just be glad this isn't a double-decker bus.
Trash Day isn't so bad if you get your hands on the Dash Trash item.
